title: OTP-24 production physical/lifecycle acceptance matrix
statement: Every physical case is BLOCKED/NOT RUN: Task 10 produced local evidence tooling only. No Windows, macOS, Chrome or phone run happened, no signature was made, and no OTP-23 waiver or historical PASS is inherited. OTP-24 is not complete.

identity_distinctions.production_binary: veles-native-host[.exe] built by ./gradlew bridgeHostBuild (locked, release, no features); its sha256 is recorded per run
identity_distinctions.test_manifest: narrowly scoped native-messaging manifest pointing at that exact executable with one exact extension origin; test-only, not the OTP-25 production registration
identity_distinctions.test_driver: host-test-driver (feature-gated example) is never acceptance evidence
identity_distinctions.scaffold: otp23-host / Tauri scaffold are never OTP-24 production evidence
identity_distinctions.macos_signing: approved PoC signed .app is a labelled test vehicle only; final production identity (me.nagaev.veles.bridge) and TCC acceptance are explicitly deferred to OTP-25 packaging; production identity is not claimed
identity_distinctions.wrapper_exception: Windows only: the never-visible Chrome wrapper, recorded per Windows Chrome case as wrapper_exception with a capture; it excuses nothing else (no visible window of the host, no endpoint, no registry/filesystem write)

failed_setups.description: Initial failed Windows background PoC setup (historical)
OTP-23 plain-host physical run with failures at the superseded MTU-517 fragmentation rule (historical)
Frozen OTP-23 remaining-case evidence incl. incidental and deliberately induced Windows AccessDenied (historical; causes differ and must not be conflated)
